title: Strutinsky macroscopic-plus-shell reading of the graded-trace residue split
html: Physical interpretation of each piece. The categorical split maps onto the Strutinsky energy decomposition E = \tilde E + \delta E_{\mathrm{shell}}. The symbol map on the graded algebra implements the Strutinsky smoothing convolution. The residue sum recovers the sharp shell fluctuations that the smoothing procedure suppresses.
